description:
Your prepaid tokens. balance: the current balance. transactions: the ledger of spends and credits, newest first.
Actions and their required fields: balance (no required fields); transactions (no required fields).

action.description: What to do: balance | transactions. The description lists the fields each action needs.

limit.description: Max transactions to return (1-100). Defaults to 20, newest first.

offset.description: How many newest transactions to skip for paging. Defaults to 0.

name: billing
